arxiv-1812-00877.title: Automatic lesion boundary detection in dermoscopy
arxiv-1812-00877.creator: Glib Kechyn
arxiv-1812-00877.description: Abstract 1 Abstract This manuscript addresses the problem of the automatic lesion boundary detection in dermoscopy, using deep neural networks. My approach is based on the adaptation of the U-net convolutional neural network with skip connections for lesion boundary segmentation task. Network was trained with the dataset provided by ISIC [ 8 ] .

arxiv-2111-07031.title: Seeing the Bigger Picture: Improving Otsu’s Thresholding Method of Global Binarization Using Ring Theory for Ultrasonographies of Congestive Heart Failure Journal: ol
arxiv-2111-07031.creator: Alisa Rahim, Esley Torres
arxiv-2111-07031.description: Abstract Ring Theory states that a ring is an algebraic structure where two binary operations can be performed among the elements: addition and multiplication. Binarization is a method of image processing where values within pixels are reduced to a scale from zero to one, with zero representing most absence of light and one representing most presence of light.

arxiv-2201-04474.title: ETH-TH/91-19, MPI-PAE-PTH/45-91 Finite Size Effects from General Covariance and Weyl Anomaly
arxiv-2201-04474.creator: A. Dettki, A. Wipf
arxiv-2201-04474.description: Abstract By exploiting the diffeomorphism invariance we relate the finite size effects of massless theories to their Weyl anomaly. We show that the universal contributions to the finite size effects are determined by certain coefficient functions in the heat kernel expansion of the related wave operators.

arxiv-2306-11643.title: On Cross-Layer Interactions of QUIC, Encrypted DNS and HTTP/3: Design, Evaluation and Dataset
arxiv-2306-11643.creator: Jayasree Sengupta 1 , Mike Kosek 2 , Justus Fries 2 , Simone Ferlin 3 , and Vaibhav Bajpai 4
arxiv-2306-11643.description: Abstract Every Web session involves a DNS resolution. While, in the last decade, we witnessed a promising trend towards an encrypted Web in general, DNS encryption has only recently gained traction with the standardisation of DNS over TLS (DoT) and DNS over HTTPS (DoH).

arxiv-2401-00326.title: Two quantum algorithms for solving the one-dimensional advection-diffusion equation Journal: Computers & Fluids
arxiv-2401-00326.creator: Julia Ingelmann, Sachin S. Bharadwaj, Philipp Pfeffer, Katepalli R. Sreenivasan, Jörg Schumacher
arxiv-2401-00326.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Julia Ingelmann, Sachin S. Bharadwaj, Philipp Pfeffer, Katepalli R. Sreenivasan, Jörg Schumacher. Two quantum algorithms are presented for the numerical solution of a linear one-dimensional advection-diffusion equation with periodic boundary conditions. Their accuracy and performance with increasing qubit number are compared point-by-point with each other.

arxiv-2409-05233.title: Enhanced Quasiparticle Relaxation in a Superconductor via the Proximity Effect
arxiv-2409-05233.creator: Kevin M. Ryan, Venkat Chandrasekhar
arxiv-2409-05233.description: Abstract Quasiparticle relaxation in pure superconductors is thought to be determined by the intrinsic inelastic scattering rate in the material. In certain applications, i.e. superconducting qubits and circuits, excess quasiparticles exist at densities far beyond the thermal equilibrium level, potentially leading to dephasing and energy loss.

arxiv-2505-13590.title: Formation and evolution of boxy/peanut bulges in the Auriga cosmological simulations 2026 Formation and evolution of boxy/peanut bulges in the Auriga cosmological simulations – 18
arxiv-2505-13590.creator: Paula D. López, Francesca Fragkoudi, Sofía A. Cora, Cecilia Scannapieco, Rüdiger Pakmor, Robert J. J. Grand, Facundo Gómez, Federico Marinacci
arxiv-2505-13590.description: Abstract Boxy/peanut (b/p) or X-shaped bulges have been extensively explored with theory and numerical simulations of isolated galaxies. However, it is only recently that advances in hydrodynamical cosmological simulations have made it possible to explore b/p bulges in a cosmological setting, with much remaining to be understood about their formation and evolution.

arxiv-2506-17975.title: Enabling PSO-Secure Synthetic Data Sharing Using Diversity-Aware Diffusion Models
arxiv-2506-17975.creator: Mischa Dombrowski, Bernhard Kainz
arxiv-2506-17975.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mischa Dombrowski, Bernhard Kainz. Synthetic data has recently reached a level of visual fidelity that makes it nearly indistinguishable from real data, offering great promise for privacy-preserving data sharing in medical imaging. However, fully synthetic datasets still suffer from significant limitations: First and foremost, the legal aspect of sharing synthetic data is often neglected and data regulations, such as the GDPR, are largley ignored. Secondly, synthetic models fall short of matching the performance of real data, even for in-domain downstream applications.

arxiv-2508-20496.title: Multistakeholder Fairness in Tourism: What can Algorithms learn from Tourism Management?
arxiv-2508-20496.creator: Peter Müllner 1,2,∗ , Anna Schreuer 2 , Simone Kopeinik 1 , Bernhard Wieser 2 , and Dominik Kowald 1,2
arxiv-2508-20496.description: Abstract 1 Algorithmic decision-support systems, i.e., recommender systems, are popular digital tools that help tourists decide which places and attractions to explore. However, algorithms often unintentionally direct tourist streams in a way that negatively affects the environment, local communities, or other stakeholders.

pmc-10576556.title: Impact of a heart failure multidisciplinary clinic on the reduction of healthcare-related events and costs: the GEstIC study
pmc-10576556.creator: Rita Rego, Nuno Pereira, António Pinto, Sofia Pereira, Irene Marques
pmc-10576556.description: IntroductionHeart failure (HF) is the leading cause of hospitalization in the elderly in developed countries and significantly impacts public health expenditures. Patients with HF usually have associated comorbidities that require multidisciplinary management. This study aims to demonstrate the benefits of a multidisciplinary clinic in reducing all-cause hospitalizations and HF events (HF hospitalizations and urgent HF visits) in a real-world setting.

pmc-11445677.title: Guillain-Barré syndrome
pmc-11445677.creator: Nicholas Shedd, Peter Woods, Damon Hoad
pmc-11445677.description: the most common form of GBS in North America and Europe. It consists of progressive ascending limb weakness, associated with depressed or absent reflexes [1]. Variants preferentially targeting the axons of nerves include acute motor axonal neuropathy, and acute motor and sensory axonal neuropathy.

pmc-12535047.title: Integrative analysis identifies radiotherapy resistance-associated CAF subtypes shaping the tumor immune landscape in breast cancer
pmc-12535047.creator: Yingyi Li, Zhihui Zhang, Xin Liu, Yixin Cheng, Kang Li, Weihong Zheng, Zhenyu He
pmc-12535047.description: BackgroundCancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) play a critical role in the tumor microenvironment (TME) of breast cancer (BC), influencing immune evasion and treatment resistance. This study aims to explore the heterogeneity of CAFs and their impact on prognosis and radiotherapy resistance.MethodsSingle-cell RNA sequencing was used to analyze CAF subsets in BC.

pmc-12557991.title: Integrating deep learning and multi-omics features in radiation pneumonitis prediction for lung cancer patients using PET/CT
pmc-12557991.creator: Yao Ai, Weihua Ni, Wanyu Su, Xiaotong Jin, Yanting Shen, Weiqian Huang, Ziqing Xiang, Xianwen Yu, Congying Xie, Xiance Jin
pmc-12557991.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTo investigate the feasibility and accuracy of PET radiomics features, along with their combination with CT radiomics, dosiomics, and deep learning (DL) features, in predicting radiation pneumonitis (RP) in lung cancer patients treated with volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT).MethodsA total of 206 and 27 lung cancer patients who underwent VMAT with pre-treatment PET/CT imaging were enrolled from Hospital One and Hospital Two for model training and external validation, respectively.

pmc-12652416.description: N-doped carbon aerogels have garnered increasing research interest in the field of energy and environment due to their unique structural features. Organic dyes, which contain redox-active sites and act as pollutants, are attractive candidates for cathode materials in Li-ion batteries but still suffer from poor cycle stability and rate performance.

pmc-13239362.title: Counterfeit Citri Reticulatae Pericarpium Identification: Multi‐Class Detection Using Vis/NIR Spectroscopy and Residual Neural Networks
pmc-13239362.creator: Chao Ma, Mingkun Zhang, Jianwei Ma, Sudan Chen, Yunxia Yuan, Mingtong Du, Zhiyong Dai
pmc-13239362.description: The expanding market demand and high commercial value of Citri Reticulatae Pericarpium (CRP) have led to frequent counterfeiting. Rapid and non‐destructive identification of counterfeit CRP is therefore essential. This study proposes a novel detection model that integrates visible/near‐infrared (Vis/NIR) spectroscopy with deep learning algorithms.

pmc-13598519.title: Mounier–Kuhn syndrome incidentally diagnosed during the evaluation of atypical chest pain: CT findings and diagnostic challenges
pmc-13598519.creator: Chaimae Abourak, Yahya El Harras, Ittimade Nassar, Yassine Hafiani, Mohamed Mahi
pmc-13598519.description: Mounier–Kuhn syndrome, or tracheobronchomegaly, is a rare disorder characterized by abnormal enlargement of the trachea and main bronchi. It may remain clinically silent or present with recurrent respiratory infections and chronic respiratory symptoms. We report the case of a 60-year-old non-smoking man who presented with intermittent atypical chest pain without respiratory symptoms or a history of recurrent pulmonary infections.

pmc-13715468.title: Bismuth Chalcogenide‐Based Photocatalysts for Nitrogen Reduction: Recent Progress and Prospects
pmc-13715468.creator: Mukesh K. Verma, Muhammad D. Bala, Phindile B. Khoza, Tshephiso R. Papo, Mzamo L. Shozi
pmc-13715468.description: Bismuth chalcogenides and related bismuth‐based materials have recently attracted considerable attention as promising photocatalysts for sustainable nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) due to their unique electronic structures, visible‐light responsiveness, stereochemically active Bi 6s2 lone pair, and tunable band positions that facilitate nitrogen adsorption and activation.

uslaw-usc-t48-s1406f.title: 48 U.S.C. § 1406f — Judicial process; title of criminal prosecutions
uslaw-usc-t48-s1406f.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t48-s1406f.description: United States Code, Title 48 (Territories And Insular Possessions); Chapter 7 (Virgin Islands); Subchapter II (Civil Government). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. All judicial process shall run in the name of “United States of America, scilicet, the President of the United States”, and all penal or criminal prosecutions in the local courts shall be conducted in the name of and by authority.
